$comment: Community skills vendored into the composition, each pinned to one commit. This file is the whole record: what we took, from where, at which commit, under which licence, and why. `pnpm vendor:community-skills` reads it, fetches exactly these commits, runs the intake checks and rewrites the directories. Nothing here updates on its own — the ecosystem moves weekly and a skill that changes under us changes what the model is told to do.

skills.name: dsh-ppt
skills.why: One sentence or a document to an HTML deck plus an editable PPTX. Self-contained: the deck builder ships inside the skill directory and runs under the bash tool, so nothing outside the sandbox is needed. Covers the teaching-deck and report-readout requests that manuscript-support has no answer for.

skills.name: deep-structural-analysis
skills.why: Sixteen adversarial lenses with calibrated confidence, as an extra review perspective beside our own rubric. Taken despite naming web search as a phase, because it declares a search-unavailable fallback that labels every framework-anchored conclusion as theoretical inference at low confidence and prints a visible notice — which is what our own runtime, having no direct egress, needs it to do.

deferred.name: writing-guard
deferred.reason: Bundle-form, not skill-form: its SKILL.md calls `writing_audit()` twelve times, and that tool comes from the plugin half of the package. Vendoring the prose alone would instruct the model to call a tool that does not exist. Belongs in the try-install lane, where the bundle is pinned into the image whole.

deferred.name: dsh-cite
deferred.reason: Registers a model-facing tool (`cite`), not a skill. Try-install lane.

deferred.name: translation
deferred.reason: Registers a translation tool. Try-install lane.
